parsed.name: Sunpower CryoTel GT 低温制冷机
parsed.description: Sunpower CryoTel GT（第二代）低温制冷机，用于在实验中提供并维持低温环境。它可通过设定温度或功率来调节制冷状态，并带有“到温”指示（绿色指示灯与 I/O 接口的 At Temperature 引脚）。
parsed.description_en: The Sunpower CryoTel GT (generation 2) cryocooler is used in labs to provide and maintain cryogenic temperatures. It can be regulated via temperature or power setpoints and includes an at-temperature indication (green LED and an I/O “At Temperature” pin).
